Gym series · G1

Gym Heroes

Released August 14, 2000 · 132 cards

Gym Heroes is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Gym series, released in English on August 14, 2000. It has 132 cards. It includes 91 Pokémon, 35 Trainer and 6 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.
